WITH date_window AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
web_base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_window dw ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dw.d_date_sk
),
web_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dw.d_date
    FROM web_base wb
    JOIN customer c ON wb.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_window dw ON wb.ws_sold_date_sk = dw.d_date_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM web_candidates wc
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM customer sc
    WHERE sc.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.c_last_name
      AND sc.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.c_first_name
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_sales ss
          JOIN date_window sd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
          WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = sc.c_customer_sk
            AND sd.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.d_date
      )
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM customer cc
    WHERE cc.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.c_last_name
      AND cc.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.c_first_name
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN date_window cd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
          WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cc.c_customer_sk
            AND cd.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM wc.d_date
      )
)
LIMIT 100

3. 5. DATE-RANGE PRECOMPUTATION — TARGET: `date_dim.d_month_seq` and the three fact `_sold_date_sk` predicates — TRANSFORMATION: Resolve the 12-month sequence once to the exact list or range of `d_date_sk` values, then apply that integer range directly to each fact table’s sold-date key; this removes the `date_dim` join and `d_month_seq` row filter from the hot path and makes the fact indexes usable for the whole window.
